caption: The drawing consists of a central rectangular area filled with decorative floral and geometric motifs and handwritten text in German. At the top, there are two large, ornate vases or pedestals, each containing stylized red, yellow, and blue flowers and green leaves. Between the vases is a symmetrical arrangement featuring two large red and yellow flowers flanking a red urn with a lid, with small tulip-like flowers and geometric shapes behind it. Below this, in the center, is a large circular wreath of green leaves, adorned with a red and yellow bow at the top and small yellow and red flowers interspersed around the ring, enclosing more text. Surrounding the central wreath and filling the bottom and side borders are numerous colorful, stylized flower heads in red, yellow, blue, and green, with green leaves and stems curling and intertwining among them. The colors in the illustration are vivid, predominantly featuring red, yellow, green, and blue, with the handwritten text in black and some parts highlighted in orange. The background is beige or lightly stained, giving the image an antique appearance, and the entire composition is enclosed by a narrow plain border.
title: Birth Certificate
